description: Cooper Creek multi-satellite flood inundation characterisation is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bioregional Assessment Program. Abstract This dataset represents the results of an assessment and uncertainty analysis of a multi-satellite flood inundation characterisation. Data was assessed from Landsat water observations from space (WOfS) and MODIS open water likelihood (OWL). The aim is to detect impact of development on flood characteristics by pairing floods of similar magnitudes, 'pre-development’ and ‘post-development’. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Bioregional Assessment Program. Its tags are Flood duration, Flood extent, REMOTE SENSING Spectroradiometer, Uncertainty analysis. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2022-03-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CC-BY 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
